resources.string: This device supports OpenCL. Model and language requirements still apply.
GPU acceleration is not supported by this driver. Voice input uses the standard CPU engine.
GPU acceleration is unavailable on this device or build. Voice input uses the standard CPU engine.
GPU support could not be checked. Voice input can still use the standard CPU engine.

OpenCL is experimental and requires the English-244 model with English-only keyboard languages. Other models use the standard CPU engine. The model prewarms while recording and may stay loaded for up to 5 idle minutes. Android or memory pressure may release it sooner. A cold load may take 20 seconds. The GPU engine runs in a separate process; driver failures may end recognition. Turning GPU acceleration off uses the standard FUTO engine.
